name: NESCAN Local Environment Action Fund (LEAF)
summary: Small grants for community groups in Aberdeen City for climate and nature projects such as wildflower meadows, wildlife habitats and tree planting. Applicants must be NESCAN members.

amount.note: Up to £3,000 per group or organisation in any financial year

reporting: Send receipts showing what the money was spent on and return a short form on how it was spent and its impact within 6 months of funds being allocated.

calls.label: LEAF 2026/27
calls.note: Closes when all funds have been awarded; first come first served

status.quote: LEAF is OPEN for 2026/27 Apply NOW

opens.quote: Open: Tuesday, 7th July 2026 Closes when all funds have been awarded

applicant_types.quote: Any local not-for-profit community organisation with an annual income under £200,000 can apply for projects to be located in Aberdeen City.

geography.quote: Any local not-for-profit community organisation with an annual income under £200,000 can apply for projects to be located in Aberdeen City.

administered_by.quote: North East Scotland Climate Action Network (NESCAN) Hub on behalf of Aberdeen City Council, is delighted to launch LEAF

access.quote: Simply click the 'Apply now' links in the green buttons to access the application form.

window.quote: We allocate to eligible applications on a first come first served basis.

amount.quote: Yes up to a maximum of £3,000 per group or organisation for any financial year

reporting.quote: We will issue you with a short form to complete to explain how you have spent the money and the impact it has made. Please return this form within 6 months of your funds being allocated.
